script_text: Sagittarius, this week Jupiter — your ruling planet — ignites a fire in your 9th House of expansion, and nothing will feel the same. Early week, Mercury sextile Jupiter on Monday and Tuesday sparks bold ideas and breakthrough conversations, but Wednesday brings a tense Mars square that could trigger impulsive decisions — slow down. The turning point arrives Thursday when Venus trines your Sagittarius Sun, flooding your 5th House of romance with magnetic energy perfect for love. Friday through Sunday, the Sun enters your 10th House of career, spotlighting professional ambitions and a potential financial opportunity you cannot ignore. Wednesday is your worst day because Mars squares your natal Sun, creating friction, while Thursday is your power day as Venus trines your sign, opening doors in love and creativity. This week, channel your fire element energy into one bold conversation you have been avoiding. Follow for daily updates.
